integrity: The theorem has a self-contained unconditional proof and independently replayable finite checks as ancillary evidence. This package has self-review only; no external validation or audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to products of two complete graphs with both factors of order at least two. It does not classify all optimal labelings. A plausible [k]-Roman primary paper from 2023 was not fully readable; historical overlap may remain.
title: A sharp width threshold for triple Roman domination of rectangular rook graphs
